job.name: ig15_host_b
job.meaning: мужчина ~60, седые короткие волосы, седая щетина, тёмно-синий кашемировый джемпер, кресло на террасе пентхауса вечером, огни города
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a calm wealthy Russian man about 60, short neat silver hair, grey stubble, a dark navy cashmere crew-neck jumper over a white collar, a steel wristwatch. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from mid-thigh up, he sits in a dark leather lounge armchair on a penthouse terrace, slightly turned to the camera, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, a smartphone lying face down on a small side table next to a glass of water, his face large and sharp and well lit by a warm lamp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, one hand in a calm open gesture, calm confident kind expression, NO broad smile. Background: evening blue hour, soft out-of-focus city lights far below, warm lamp light on the terrace. Look: a real frame from a phone camera on a tripod, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.

attempts.issue: Deformed resting hand with an extra finger
